role: kick (inside mic) — LF thump + beater body. 80s gated kit: TIGHT + PUNCHY + controlled (drives the groove under the gated explosion).
rationale: The 80s gated kit is TIGHT + PUNCHY (it must cut through the exploding ambience). HPF 32 + a -2 @31.5 control the sub; -3 @350 de-boxes; +2 @3.5k gives the beater a defined CLICK (more present than the dark Bonham recipe). A small positive transient (snare/mid band a touch more) restores attack the gate will key off. API New(FF) 4:1 Medium adds forward density; lf +1 @60. declick off.

role: kick beater / click mic — owns attack. 80s: a defined click that sits under the 'in' mic.
rationale: HPF 90 hands the thump to the 'in' mic; -3 @200 kills box; +2.5 @3.5k presents a defined click; a gentle 5.5-7.5k de-harsh keeps it from spitting. declick off.

role: snare top — THE STAR of the gated sound: full body + a strong CRACK, punchy attack (the gate keys off this).
rationale: The 80s gated snare is the centerpiece. -1.5 @300 de-boxes; +2.5 @5k = the CRACK that explodes through the gated room; a positive transient (esp. the upper band) restores the SNAP the bus gate keys off (transient snap is ALLOWED here — unlike home-at-last's dynamics-preserving rule — because the 80s snare is processed/punchy). 6-8k de-harsh guards against spit. API New(FF) 4:1 Medium for forward density. declick off.

role: snare bottom (wires) — buzz/snap detail under the top.
rationale: HPF 150 kills shell-ring; -4/-2.5 @200/400 de-box; +2 @7k presents the wire snap; 6-8k de-harsh keeps it smooth. Sits under the top to thicken the snap the gate keys off. declick off.

role: hi-hat (close mic) — RESTRAINED (the iconic intro had none); present but never splashy.
rationale: Kept restrained (the famous intro is hatless; a real kit needs a hat but it must not steal from the gated snare/tom). HPF 120 + -4 @250 + -2.5 @450 clear rumble/whoosh; only a tiny +0.5 @9k sizzle; 5-7k de-harsh tames spit. declick off.

role: overheads (stereo) — clean kit image. The BUS owns the 'room', so the OH stays controlled (not the ambience star).
rationale: The OH is the kit image, NOT the ambience (the bus synthesizes the gated room). HPF 130 dumps the kick lump; -2 @250 eases box; only a tiny +0.5 @11k sheen guarded by a 3.5-6.5k de-harsh. Old(FB) 2:1 for cohesion. declick off.

role: room/ambience (stereo) — OPTIONAL + redundant here (the BUS makes the gated room). Kept tight + far down, or omit.
rationale: Inversion vs fool-in-the-rain: the room is NOT the star and is REDUNDANT here (the bus synthesizes the gated ambience). HPF 80 + -2 @220 keep any real room channel tight; balance it FAR down (or omit the stem entirely). declick off.
